description: Cursor Agent CLI as a bare stateless engine node — the same three wakes as engine-cursor, invoked with --permissions bypass. Cursor's strongest mode is auto and the base preset already composes it, so this definition is identical to engine-cursor today; the name states the intent, and it picks up any stronger mode cursor grows. An unrestricted node acts on untrusted inbound mail — anyone who can reach its inbox, including over a broker or a shared folder, is driving a CLI that will not ask. Only for an agent on its own machine and its own account.
